_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for the #1931 visually-blank proof (r2 C0/C1 control characters + the r1 primary defect: U+2800 BRAILLE PATTERN BLANK and the three Hangul fillers). Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-preuves.mts BEFORE classification. Each test declared in `expectedRed` MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code. If a declared kept-red test PASSES, the runner fails CI with verdict DECLARED RED PASSED (proof is stale) — the bug changed form or was weakened (the adverse mutations are documented in the proof file's docblock: Mechanism I drops the Braille structural branch, Mechanism II narrows \p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point} back to \p{Cf}, Mechanism III drops \p{Cc}).

expectedRed.testName: U+0001 (SOH) renders blank — the bug the r1 predicate missed
expectedRed.why: On corrected code, \p{Cc} strips U+0001, the function returns the marker, and `rendered('\u0001')` equals 'NO_CAUSE' not '\u0001'. The assertion `expect(rendered('\u0001')).toBe('\u0001')` FAILS with AssertionError — the kept-red state. If this test PASSES, \p{Cc} has been dropped from the predicate and the r2 defect is back (Mechanism III).

expectedRed.testName: U+0007 (BEL) renders blank — the bug the r1 predicate missed
expectedRed.why: On corrected code, \p{Cc} strips U+0007, the function returns the marker, and `rendered('\u0007')` equals 'NO_CAUSE' not '\u0007'. The assertion FAILS — kept-red. If PASSES, \p{Cc} dropped (Mechanism III).

expectedRed.why: On corrected code, \p{Cc} strips U+007F, the function returns the marker, and `rendered('\u007F')` equals 'NO_CAUSE' not '\u007F'. The assertion FAILS — kept-red. If PASSES, \p{Cc} dropped (Mechanism III).

expectedRed.why: On corrected code, \p{Cc} strips U+0085, the function returns the marker, and `rendered('\u0085')` equals 'NO_CAUSE' not '\u0085'. The assertion FAILS — kept-red. If PASSES, \p{Cc} dropped (Mechanism III).

expectedRed.why: On corrected code, \p{Cc} strips U+009F, the function returns the marker, and `rendered('\u009F')` equals 'NO_CAUSE' not '\u009F'. The assertion FAILS — kept-red. If PASSES, \p{Cc} dropped (Mechanism III).

U+2800 is category So — not default-ignorable, not Cc — so the corrected classifier uses the Braille script property and zero dot mask to strip it. The function returns the marker and `rendered('\u2800')` equals 'NO_CAUSE' not '\u2800' — the assertion FAILS with AssertionError, the kept-red state. If this test PASSES, the Braille structural branch has been dropped and the PRIMARY #1931 defect is back (Mechanism I).

U+3164 is Lo, covered only by \p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point}. On corrected code it is stripped, the marker is returned, and `rendered('\u3164')` equals 'NO_CAUSE' not '\u3164' — the assertion FAILS, the kept-red state. If this test PASSES, the property has been narrowed (e.g. back to \p{Cf}, which does not cover Lo) and the Hangul-filler half of #1931 is back (Mechanism II).
U+115F is Lo, property-covered. On corrected code the marker is returned — the assertion FAILS, kept-red. If PASSES, the property has been narrowed and #1931 is back (Mechanism II).
